reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT o.ship_to_country, AVG(t.order_eur) AS avg_order_eur
FROM order_totals t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
GROUP BY o.ship_to_country

solver.query:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.ship_to_country, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.ship_to_country
)
SELECT ship_to_country, AVG(order_eur) AS avg_order_eur
FROM per_order
GROUP BY ship_to_country
